BiblicalUsage: Zelophehad was a man of Manasseh who died in the wilderness leaving five daughters and no sons. His daughters — Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah — stood before Moses and asked for their father's inheritance, and God said their cause was right. The law of inheritance was changed because five daughters spoke up.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the daughters of Zelophehad changed the law because they trusted God's justice enough to ask. My position is that God hears daughters who stand up for what is right, and His law bends toward justice.
